claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: An exothermic reaction transfers heat across its boundary. In which direction is that heat transferred? In an exothermic process, heat is transferred from the system to its surroundings. This direction concerns heat transfer, not a guarantee about the temperature of every object.
The circles are symbolic labels, not molecular structures, and the model omits other conditions or intermediate steps.
